verdict.rationale: Foreign-qualification filing is a fair question for a registered-agent and corporate-compliance provider like CT Corporation, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and legacy pages redirect into that walled host. No CT Corporation content documents a foreign-qualification filing service, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider handles the foreign-qualification filing when the company registers to do business in an additional state
